core_obligations: Recall that omega^bullet_{X/S} is S-perfect (proof lines 7540-7542).
Push the rigidity isomorphism along the diagonal and identify the target with RSheafHom(Delta_*O_X, Lpr_1^* omega^bullet_{X/S}) (proof lines 7542-7558).
proof_roadmap: The diagonal calculation finishing the proof (proof lines 7542-7558).
difficulty_reason: Let S be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let f : X -> S be proper, flat and of finite presentation; the lemma asserts that the relative dualizing complex omega^bullet_{X/S} of Remark labelled remark-relative-dualizing-complex, together with the isomorphism (equation-pre-rigid), is a relative dualizing complex in the sense of Definition labelled definition-relative-dualizing-complex (statement lines 7529-7538). The proof uses the earlier result Lemma labelled lemma-properties-relative-dualizing that omega^bullet_{X/S} is S-perfect, then applies the right adjoint c of the diagonal morphism of Lemma labelled lemma-twisted-inverse-image and pushes (equation-pre-rigid) forward along the diagonal, obtaining an isomorphism Delta_*O_X -> Delta_*(c(Lpr_1^* omega^bullet_{X/S})) = RSheafHom(Delta_*O_X, Lpr_1^* omega^bullet_{X/S}) (proof lines 7540-7558). The equality of the two displayed objects uses Lemmas labelled lemma-twisted-inverse-image-closed and lemma-sheaf-with-exact-support-ext. Rewriting the rigidity isomorphism as an isomorphism against RSheafHom of the diagonal structure sheaf is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
